versions.content: ImplementationDataTypes need the same Type- Emitter The value of the attribute typeEmitter shall be identical for all ImplementationDataTypes being covered by [SWS_Rte_02648] when their def- initions would result in the same Implementation Data Type symbol (see [SWS_Rte_06716],[SWS_Rte_06717]). The typeEmitter value " RTE " shall be con- sidered identical to a not defined typeEmitter in this context (see [SWS_Rte_06709] and [SWS_Rte_06710]).
